title: Growing Demand for Hollow Sections and Rectangular Aluminium Extrusions
subtitle: Why the construction sector is shifting to hollow section steel
content:
As construction evolves in Nigeria, hollow sections are increasingly favoured for their superior strength-to-weight ratio. Engineers and builders are turning to Square Hollow Sections (SHS), Rectangular Hollow Sections (RHS), and Circular Hollow Sections (CHS) as the backbone of modern structural frameworks.

Ridmax Steel stocks a comprehensive range of hollow sections in various grades and wall thicknesses. Whether you are constructing a commercial building, industrial shed, or residential gate, our hollow sections offer the precision and durability you need.

Contact our sales team for current stock availability and pricing.

title: Steel Demand in Nigeria: Market Trends and Future Projections
subtitle: What industry experts are saying about Nigeria's steel market
content:
Nigeria's steel market continues to record strong growth driven by a booming construction sector, government infrastructure investments, and rising domestic manufacturing activity. According to industry analysts, the country's steel consumption is projected to grow at a compounded annual rate of over 8% through 2030.

Key drivers include the federal government's housing and road infrastructure programmes, an increase in private real estate development, and expanding manufacturing clusters in Lagos, Ogun, and Kano states.

For Ridmax Steel, this growth presents a significant opportunity to serve more clients with our extensive range of quality steel products. We are expanding our distribution network and deepening our supplier partnerships to ensure we remain Nigeria's most reliable steel partner.
